blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Transformer sentence encoders provide strong retrieval quality, but their inference cost becomes a bottleneck when embeddings must be produced on CPUs or refreshed frequently. We introduce StaRSE, a compact Russian static sentence encoder that removes Transformer inference at deployment time: token directions are stored as sign bits, token norms are stored separately, and sentences are encoded by mean pooling over norm-scaled sign directions. StaRSE is initialized from ruBERT-base, fine-tuned on Russian adjacent-sentence and task-shaped pairs, and post-trained with a contrastive stage that directly optimizes the sign-projected token table. On RuMTEB, StaRSE reaches a task mean of $51.16$, $7.98$ points above the strongest included static baseline. The packaged model occupies $11.3$ MiB and has a mean CPU latency of $0.08$ ms per sentence, compared with an estimated $55.7$ MiB 16-bit parameter footprint and $1.43$ ms mean CPU latency for the closest-quality contextual encoder. Ablations examine adjacent-sentence supervision, token norms, and direct sign-projected post-training.
blocks.zh: 变形器句子编码器提供了很强的取回质量,但其推论成本在必须被嵌入到CPU上或被频繁刷新时会成为一个瓶颈. 我们引入了StaRSE,一个紧凑的俄罗斯静态句子编码器,在部署时去除变形器推论:符号指向被存储为符号比特,符号规范被单独存储,句子被用"平均集合"来编码在规范的标分指向上. StaRSE从ruBERT-base开始初始化,在俄罗斯相邻的发音和任务形对上进行微调,后受训练阶段直接优化了所投放的标志表. 在RUMTEB,Starse达到51.16美元的任务平均值,比最强的固定基线高出7.98美元。 被包装的型号占用了11.3美元MiB,平均CPU的空闲时间为每句0.08美元,相较于估计的55.7美元MiB 16位参数脚印和1.43分指CPU对最上等上下文编码器的空闲时间. 监外执行检查相邻的监外执行,象征性规范,直接招牌预测后培训.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text embedding models are now a standard component of neural retrieval systems, semantic search, clustering, deduplication, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation.
The strongest general-purpose embedding models are contextual encoders, typically trained or adapted with sentence-level contrastive objectives ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) .
Their quality, however, comes with a deployment cost: every query and document requires a Transformer forward pass ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) .
This cost is often acceptable for reranking ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ) or small collections, but it becomes restrictive when embeddings must be produced on CPU, refreshed frequently, served under tight latency budgets, or computed for very large text collections.
blocks.zh:
文本嵌入模型现在是神经检索系统,语义检索,集群,解码,推荐,以及检索-增强生成的标准组成部分.
最强的通用嵌入模型是上下文编码器,通常经过培训或调整后具有句级对比性目标(Reimers and Gurevych, 2019;Gao等人, 2021;Wang等人, 2024;Li等人, 2023)。
然而,它们的质量伴随着部署费用:每个查询和文件都需要一个变形器前行通行证(Vaswani等人,2017年)。
这种成本通常可以被重新排序(Nogueira and Cho, 2019)或小收藏所接受,但当嵌入物必须在CPU上生产,经常刷新,在紧凑的延迟预算下服务,或者为非常大的文本收藏所计算时会变得限制性.

blocks.en:
Static embedding models, from word2vec ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) , GloVe ( Pennington et al., 2014 ) , and fastText ( Bojanowski et al., 2017 ) to sentence-level and recent static embedding variants ( Pagliardini et al., 2018 ; Wada et al., 2025 ; Tulkens and van Dongen, 2024 ) , offer a different point in this quality-cost trade-off.
At inference time, they use a fixed vocabulary, a simple lookup table, pooling over token vectors, and normalization.
This makes inference cheap and predictable, especially on CPUs and resource-constrained hardware.
The price is a strict architectural bottleneck: a mean-pooled static embedding model cannot model word order, contextual word senses, or compositional interactions in the way a Transformer can.
The practical question is therefore not whether static embedding models should replace contextual encoders, but whether they can provide useful retrieval quality at much lower serving cost.
blocks.zh:
静态嵌入模型,从word2vec(Mikolov等人,2013年),GloVe(Pennington等人,2014年),以及快腾(Bojanowski等人,2017年)到句位和近期的静态嵌入变体(Pagliardini等人,2018年;Wada等人,2025年;Tulkens和van Dongen,2024年),为这种质量成本权衡提供了不同的点.
在推论时,它们使用固定的词汇,简单的检索表,集合在符号矢量之上,并实现正常化.
这使得推论成本低廉且可预测,特别是在CPU和受资源限制的硬件上.
价格是一个严格的建筑瓶颈:一个平均集合的静态嵌入模型无法以变形器可以的方式模拟词序,上下文的单词感知,或组成互动.
因此,实际问题不是静态嵌入模型是否应当取代上下文编码器,而是它们是否能够以低得多的服务成本提供有用的检索质量.

blocks.en:
This question is underexplored for Russian and, more broadly, for language-specific efficient retrieval outside English.
Recent Russian sentence transformers include strong contextual models such as FRIDA ( Snegirev et al., 2025 ) and GigaEmbeddings ( Kolodin et al., 2025 ) .
Russian static embedding models, however, remain mostly word-level, while multilingual static embedding models are not optimized specifically for Russian morphology and vocabulary coverage.
We treat Russian as one instance of a broader setting: languages with large text corpora but limited high-quality labeled sentence pairs, for which a reusable static-encoder training recipe may be useful.
blocks.zh:
这个问题对俄语和更广泛的英语以外的特定语言有效检索没有得到充分探讨。
最近俄罗斯的句子变换器包括强大的上下文模型,如FRIDA(Snegirev等人,2025年)和GigaEmbeddings(Kolodin等人,2025年).
然而,俄罗斯的静态嵌入模型仍然大多为词级,而多语种的静态嵌入模型并没有专门为俄罗斯形态学和词汇覆盖进行优化.
我们把俄语当作一种更广泛的背景:使用大字形、但质量有限的高标签句子的语言,对于这些语言,可重复使用的静态编码器培训方法可能是有用的。

blocks.en:
We introduce StaRSE , a static sentence encoder for Russian with a sign-coded token table: token directions are stored as sign bits, while per-token scalar norms are stored separately. The pipeline deliberately combines established ingredients from static embeddings and contrastive sentence embedding training: Transformer input embeddings, token-level dimensionality reduction, frequency weighting, adjacent-sentence positives, and InfoNCE-style optimization. The main StaRSE-specific component is the compact sign-coded token table with mean pooling over norm-scaled sign directions and a final training stage that computes the contrastive loss through the sign-projected table instead of signing a continuous table only after training. At deployment time, StaRSE stores only the compact token table and encodes text by pooling norm-scaled sign directions, avoiding Transformer inference for both queries and documents.
Figure 1 shows this trade-off numerically: StaRSE reaches 51.16 51.16 task mean on RuMTEB, 7.98 7.98 points above the strongest included static encoder, and remains within 2.60 2.60 points of ruBERT-tiny-turbo. In Table 4 , StaRSE’s measured package is 11.3 11.3 MiB, while the estimated 16-bit parameter footprint of ruBERT-tiny-turbo is 55.7 55.7 MiB. Under the same CPU protocol, StaRSE has about 18 × 18\times lower mean single-sentence latency ( 0.08 0.08 versus 1.43 1.43 ms).
Larger contextual encoders remain substantially more accurate, but they occupy a different cost range.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Static word embeddings were the dominant vector representation before the rise of contextual encoders.
Models such as word2vec ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) , GloVe ( Pennington et al., 2014 ) , and fastText ( Bojanowski et al., 2017 ) assign one vector to each vocabulary unit.
Sentence or document vectors were then commonly built compositionally, for example by averaging word vectors, adding n n -gram features as in Sent2Vec ( Pagliardini et al., 2018 ) , or applying simple weighting and post-processing heuristics.
These approaches are attractive because inference reduces to lookup and pooling, but their tables are usually optimized for word-level distributional semantics rather than for general-purpose sentence embeddings.
blocks.zh:
静态词嵌入是上下文编码器出现之前的主要矢量表示.
word2vec(Mikolov等人,2013年),GloVe(Pennington等人,2014年),fastText(Bojanowski等人,2017年)等模型为每个词汇单元分配了一个矢量.
然后,句子或文档矢量通常通过组成方式构建,例如通过平均单词矢量,在Sent2Vec(Pagliardini等人,2018年)中添加n-gram特性,或者应用简单的加权和处理后heuristics.
这些方法很有吸引力,因为推论减少寻找和集合,但其表格通常被优化为词级分布语义而非通用句子嵌入.

blocks.en:
Contextual encoders now provide the strongest sentence representations.
BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) introduced contextual token representations, and Sentence-BERT ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) adapted Transformer encoders for efficient sentence-level similarity.
We use Sentence Transformer (ST) as a shorthand for Transformer encoders trained or adapted to produce sentence-level embeddings directly.
Later STs and related contextual embedding systems such as SimCSE ( Gao et al., 2021 ) , E5 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and GTE ( Li et al., 2023 ) improved embedding quality through successive changes to the training pipeline and data construction.
MTEB ( Muennighoff et al., 2023 ) broadened evaluation beyond STS to information retrieval (IR), reranking, classification, clustering, and pair classification, including natural language inference (NLI)-style tasks.
This progress made STs the default choice for high-quality embeddings, while static models remained attractive when CPU latency, memory use, indexing cost, or hardware availability are limiting factors.
blocks.zh:
上下文编码器现在提供了最强的句子表示.
BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)引入了背景符号表示,Priment-BERT(Reimers and Gurevych,2019年)为了高效的句子级别相似性而改装了变形器编码器.
我们使用"句子变形器"(ST)作为为直接生成句子级别嵌入而训练或改造的变形器编码器的简称.
后来的ST和相关的上下文嵌入系统如SimCSE(Gao等人,2021年),E5(Wang等人,2024年),以及GTE(Li等人,2023年)通过对培训管道和数据构建的连续修改,提高了嵌入质量.
MTEB(Muennighoff等人,2023年)将评价范围从STS扩大到信息检索(IR),重新排序,分类,集群,以及对称分类,包括自然语言推论(NLI)式的任务.
这一进步使得STs成为高质量嵌入的默认选择,而静态模型在CPU闲置,内存使用,索引成本,或硬件可用性等限制因素时仍然具有吸引力.

blocks.en:
Recent work has revisited static embedding models by reusing representations from pretrained Transformer models.
WordLlama recycles the input token embeddings of LLaMA-family models and trains a lightweight context-free text embedding model from them ( Miller, 2024 ) .
Model2Vec instead distills a static vocabulary table from an existing sentence embedding model, producing a fast lookup-and-pooling model without running the teacher at inference time ( Tulkens and van Dongen, 2024 ) .
A third line starts from contextualized word representations: contextual models assign different vectors to the same word in different sentences ( Ethayarajh, 2019 ) , and these contextual vectors can be reduced to static word representations by aggregating occurrences ( Bommasani et al., 2020 ) .
Wada and colleagues apply this idea to sentence embeddings by collecting many corpus occurrences of each word, encoding them in context, and averaging the resulting token representations into one static vector ( Wada et al., 2025 ) .
These recipes differ in what they require.
Input-embedding reuse and teacher distillation need a pretrained model and its vocabulary, whereas occurrence-based extraction also needs a corpus with enough contexts for each vocabulary item.
Such extraction can be computationally expensive because it requires many Transformer forward passes to collect last-hidden-state token representations before the static table can be built.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作通过重新使用预先训练过的变形器模型的表示,重新审视了静态嵌入模型。
WordLlama循环LLaMA-家族模型的输入符嵌入,并从中训练一种轻量级无上下文文本嵌入模型(Miller,2024).
Model2Vec转而从现存的句子嵌入模型中提炼出一个静态词汇表,在推论时间不运行老师的情况下产生快速的仰望和集合模型(Tulkens and van Dongen, 2024).
第三行从上下文化的单词表示开始:上下文模型在不同句子中为同一个单词指定不同的矢量(Ethayarajh, 2019),这些上下文的矢量可以通过集合发生量来缩小为静态单词表示(Bommasani等人, 2020).
Wada和同事们将这一想法应用于句子的嵌入,收集每个词的许多实体事件,将它们编码在上下文中,并将由此产生的符号表示值平均为一个静态矢量(Wada等人,2025年)。
这些配方的要求各不相同。
输入式嵌入式再利用和教师蒸馏需要经过事先训练的模型及其词汇,而基于发生式的提取还需要一个对每个词汇项目具有足够上下文的体格.
此类提取可能计算费用昂贵,因为它需要许多变形器前传通行证来收集最后隐藏的状态表示符才能构建静态表.

blocks.en:
Dimensionality reduction and token weighting are central to the initialization and post-processing used in these static models.
WordLlama and Model2Vec apply PCA to the token embedding matrix, while Wada et al. (2025) argue for sentence-level PCA, in which PCA is fitted to averaged sentence representations so that the retained axes better reflect sentence-level variance.
In both cases, PCA can be combined with All-but-the-Top (ABTT) post-processing, which discards a small number of dominant principal components instead of simply keeping the leading ones ( Mu and Viswanath, 2018 ) .
This can reduce the influence of common directions that appear across many embeddings and can otherwise dominate cosine similarities.
Frequency-based weighting addresses a different issue: very frequent tokens often contribute less semantic specificity to an averaged sentence vector.
SIF ( Arora et al., 2017 ) downweights frequent tokens using corpus frequency.
When reliable counts are unavailable, a Zipfian prior over vocabulary rank provides a simple approximation ( Piantadosi, 2014 ) .

在这两种情况下,五氯苯甲醚都可以与All-but-the-Top(ABTT)的后处理结合,它丢弃了少量主导性的主要组件,而不是简单地保留主导组件(Mu and Viswanath, 2018).
这可以减少在许多嵌入物中出现的共同方向的影响,否则可以支配余弦的相似性.

blocks.en:
After initialization and post-processing, static embedding models are often trained with either distillation or contrastive learning.
Knowledge distillation transfers information from a stronger teacher to a smaller student ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) .
For STs, this can mean matching teacher sentence vectors, matching pairwise teacher similarities within a batch, or aligning multilingual sentence spaces ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2020 ; Wada et al., 2025 ) .
Distillation is attractive because it can create a static model from a teacher and vocabulary without a labeled pair dataset, but direct vector matching constrains the student to approximate a teacher geometry with much lower capacity.
Contrastive learning instead trains the model to score positive pairs above in-batch or explicitly sampled negatives, as in InfoNCE-style embedding fine-tuning ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ; Sturua et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
在初始化和后处理后,静态嵌入模型往往通过蒸馏或对比性学习得到训练.
知识蒸馏将信息从更强的教师转移到更小的学生(Hinton等人,2015年).
对于STs来说,这可以指匹配师语句向量,匹配批次中的双向师语相似性,或者对齐多语种句子空间(Reimers and Gurevych, 2020;Wada等人, 2025).
抖动是有吸引力的,因为它可以从老师和词汇中创建一个没有标签的配对数据集的静态模型,但是直接矢量匹配会约束学生对能力低得多的老师几何进行近似.
对比性学习转而训练模型,将正对分数分到比对上方或明确取样的负数,如InfoNCE式嵌入微调(van den Oord等人,2018年;Sturua等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Embedding compression is another way to reduce memory and search cost for embedding models.
Some text-retrieval and sentence-representation systems binarize final dense sentence or passage vectors so nearest-neighbor search can use Hamming distance or equivalent bit operations ( Shen et al., 2019 ; Hamann et al., 2019 ; Yamada et al., 2021 ) .
In our work, StaRSE uses a different form of compression: it stores sign-projected token directions and separate scalar token norms, while the pooled sentence vector remains real-valued.
Vector and weight quantization reduce memory and arithmetic precision, as in quantization-aware training for neural network inference ( Jacob et al., 2018 ) .
Quantization-aware methods are useful when post-hoc quantization would change the representation seen by the loss: training with the quantized forward path lets the objective optimize the representation used at inference.
blocks.zh:
嵌入压缩是降低嵌入模型的内存和搜索成本的另一种方法.
一些文本检索和句子表示系统将最终密集的句子或通道矢量二元化,因此最近的邻域搜索可以使用汉明距离或等效位操作(沈等人,2019年;哈曼等人,2019年;山田等人,2021年).
在我们的作品中,StaRSE使用不同的压缩形式:它存储了标注的符号方向和单独的scalar符号规范,而集合句矢量仍然具有真实价值.
矢量和重量量化降低了内存和算术精度,如神经网络推论的量化-意识训练(Jacob等人,2018年).
量子化后的量子化会改变损失所见的表示方式:用量子化的前进路径进行训练,使客观能优化推论中所使用的表示方式,因此,量子化-感知方法是有用的.

blocks.en:
Russian embedding research follows the broader contextual trend.
RuMTEB provides a Russian version of MTEB with the same broad task families ( Snegirev et al., 2025 ) , while RusBEIR collects Russian information-retrieval tasks for retrieval-focused evaluation ( Kovalev et al., 2025 ) .
Recent Russian sentence-embedding work includes FRIDA ( Snegirev et al., 2025 ) and GigaEmbeddings ( Kolodin et al., 2025 ) .
GigaEmbeddings combines large-scale contrastive pre-training with hard-negative and multitask fine-tuning, synthetic data, and efficient contextual pooling.
Russian static embedding models are mostly word-level: Navec 3 3 3 https://github.com/natasha/navec and DeepPavlov 4 4 4 https://docs.deeppavlov.ai/en/master/features/pretrained_vectors.html both provide compact Russian word embeddings.
These models are lightweight, but using them for sentence-level semantics typically requires adapting word-level vectors rather than using a model trained for sentence-level similarity.
When static text embedders are multilingual, their vocabulary and capacity are shared across languages rather than targeted to Russian.
This leaves room for a Russian-specific static sentence encoder trained directly for sentence-level retrieval.

最近俄罗斯的判刑组合工作包括: FRIDA(Snegirev等人,2025年)和GigaEmbeddings(Kolodin等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
StaRSE is built in three steps.
First, we choose a tokenizer vocabulary and initialize the static token table from a pretrained Transformer encoder input embedding matrix (Sec. 3.1 ).
Second, we construct weak positive pairs from source documents by pairing adjacent sentences (Sec. 3.2 ).
Third, we train the table with a bidirectional InfoNCE loss and then continue training with the sign-projected token table used at inference time (Sec. 3.3 ).

第二,我们通过对相邻的句子进行配对,从源文档中构建弱正对(第3.2条)。
第三,我们用双向的InfoNCE损失来训练桌子,然后用推论时间(第3.3节)使用的标注符号表继续训练。

The first design choice is the vocabulary.
A static embedding model inherits both its coverage and its tokenization behavior from a fixed vocabulary V V .

blocks.en: 3.2 Document Pair Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 文件平面建筑

blocks.en:
Curated sentence-pair datasets provide high-quality supervision, but for most languages there are few large, diverse, and reliably labeled pair collections.
This is especially limiting for a general static sentence encoder.
Unlike a Sentence Transformer, StaRSE does not retain a pretrained contextual encoder at inference time.
The input embedding matrix gives a lexical and subword-level starting point, but sentence-level similarity must be induced in the token table itself during training.
blocks.zh:
被破解的句子-pair数据集提供高质量的监督,但对于大多数语言来说,很少有大,多样,且有可靠标签的配对集合.
这对一般的静态句式编码器特别有限制.
与句式变形器不同,StarSE在推论时间没有保留一个经过预先训练的上下文编码器.
输入嵌入矩阵给出了词汇和子词层次的起点,但句子层次的相似性必须在训练期间在符号表本身中诱导.

blocks.en:
Document collections provide a broad weakly supervised signal for this purpose.
The use of adjacent sentences follows the same basic intuition as BERT’s next sentence prediction objective ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) : consecutive text segments often carry discourse information.
We use this signal differently.
Instead of training a classifier to decide whether two segments are consecutive, we use adjacent sentences as positive pairs for contrastive training.
Adjacent sentences are not guaranteed to be paraphrases: they may continue the same topic or discourse without expressing the same meaning.
Nevertheless, document adjacency preserves topic continuity, entities, discourse relations, and local semantic coherence more often than random cross-document pairing.
Section 5.2 examines this assumption empirically with a diagnostic sentence encoder.
We therefore treat adjacent sentences as weak positives rather than exact semantic equivalents.

与其训练一个分类员来决定两个段是否是连续的,我们用相邻的句子作为正对对对比性训练.
相邻的句子不能被保证作解释:它们可以继续同一个话题或论述而不表达相同的含义.
尽管如此,与随机的交叉文件配对相比,文档的辅音保留了主题的连续性,实体,话语关系,以及本地语义的一致性.

因此,我们将相邻的句子视为弱阳性,而不是精确的语义等效.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
This section describes the experimental setup and results for StaRSE.
We specify the training data, model configuration, baselines, and evaluation protocol, then report RuMTEB, long-document retrieval, and encoding-efficiency results.
All RuMTEB scores and nDCG@ 10 10 values are reported on a 0 0 – 100 100 scale throughout the paper; their differences are expressed in points on this scale.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍StaRSE的实验设置和结果.
我们具体说明培训数据、模型配置、基线和评价协议,然后报告RuMTEB、长文件检索和编码效率结果。
所有 RUMTEB 分数和nDCG@ 10 10 个值均以 0 – 100 100 比例表全纸上报;它们的差异以这个比例表的分数表示.

blocks.en: 4.1 Training Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训数据

blocks.en:
The contrastive fine-tuning recipe combines adjacent sentence pairs from Cultura RU Edu 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepvk/cultura_ru_edu with Russian retrieval and paraphrase-style pair sources.
We use Cultura as the broad text source because adjacent sentences expose entities, topics, and discourse transitions that are less common in small supervised similarity datasets.
Following Section 3.2 , we use the Razdel library 6 6 6 https://github.com/natasha/razdel to split Cultura documents into sentences and form candidate pairs from consecutive sentences ( s i , s i + 1 ) (s_{i},s_{i+1}) in the same document. Cultura pairs are retained with the lemma-overlap filter from Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh:
对比性微调配方结合了来自Cultura RU Edu 5 5 5的相邻句子对. https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepvk/cultula_ru_edu与俄罗斯检索和准词风格的配对源.
我们使用Cultura作为广义的文本来源,因为相邻的句子暴露了在小的监管相似度数据集中不太常见的实体,主题和语句过渡.
第3.2节之后,我们利用Razdel图书馆 6 6 6 https://github.com/natasha/razdel将Cultura文件分为句子,并形成同一文件中连续句子(si,si + 1)的候选人对(s_{i},s_{i+1}). 第3.2节的羊膜覆膜过滤器保留了阴茎对。

blocks.en:
The remaining sources provide more task-shaped positives.
From the Russian subset of the mMARCO IR passage-ranking dataset ( Bonifacio et al., 2021 ) , we use the query and the positive passage from each training triple.
From the ru-HNP paraphrase dataset, 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepvk/ru-HNP we treat each source text and its positive paraphrases as a positive set and form all unordered pairs within that set. From ru-paraphrase-NMT-Leipzig, 8 8 8 https://huggingface.co/datasets/cointegrated/ru-paraphrase-NMT-Leipzig a paraphrase/translation dataset, we use the original and back-translated pair.
Basic normalization removes empty, identical, and overlong pairs. During continuous training, a source-balanced sampler prevents the smaller supervised datasets from being overwhelmed by Cultura.
blocks.zh:
其余来源提供了更多任务形状的阳性.
从mMARCO IR分集的俄罗斯分集通过等级数据集(Bonifacio et al., 2021)中,我们使用查询和每次训练三进制的正通过.
从ru-HNP的参数数据集,7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepvk/ru-HNP 我们把每个源文本及其正式参数当作一个正式集,并在该集中形成所有无序对。 从ru-parale-NMT-Leipzig, 8 8 8 https://huggingface.co/datasets/cocomplete/ru-parale-NMT-Leipzig 的一个参数/翻译数据集,我们使用原始和反翻译的对.
基本正常化可以去除空的,相同的,和超长的对. 在持续训练期间,一个源平衡的采样器可以防止较小的受监督的数据集被Cultura压倒.

blocks.en: 4.2 Model and Training Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式和培训设置

blocks.en:
StaRSE uses the WordPiece tokenizer and vocabulary of ruBERT-base 9 9 9 https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/ruBert-base , with 120,138 120{,}138 tokens.
The final model keeps this vocabulary fixed and learns one table row for each token.
Section 5.1 provides the development results behind the tokenizer and initialization choices.
blocks.zh:
StaRSE使用WordPiece的表示器和ruBERT-base 9 9 9的词汇 https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/ruBert-base,有120,138 120{,}138个表示器.
最终的模型保持了这个词汇的固定,并学习每个符号一个表格行.
第5.1节提供了说明剂和初始化选择背后的发展成果。

blocks.en: We initialize the final 512 512 -dimensional table from the corresponding input embedding matrix using token-level PCA, ABTT, and SIF-Zipf weighting, as selected in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 正如第5.1节所选择的那样,我们使用符号级五氯苯甲醚、ABTT和SIF-Zipf加权法从相应的输入嵌入矩阵中初始化最后的512 512维表。

blocks.en: Continuous contrastive training has two phases, both optimizing only the symmetric pair loss ℒ pairs ​ ( ℬ , s ) \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{pairs}}(\mathcal{B};s) from Section 3.3 . The first phase runs for 20,000 20{,}000 steps on the four-source mixture. The second continues for 10,000 10{,}000 steps, and its final checkpoint initializes the sign-projected post-training stage and serves as its frozen teacher.
blocks.zh: 持续对比训练分两个阶段,两个阶段都优化了来自科的对称对称对子损失 L 配对 (B, s)\ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{pairs}}(\mathcal{B};s) 3.3 (英语). 第一阶段运行为20,000 20{,}000步在四源混合物上. 第二步持续10000 10{,}000步,其最后的检查站初始化了标注的训练后阶段,并担任其冻结的老师.

blocks.en:
The final stage starts from this mixed-source checkpoint and trains on Cultura through the sign-projected table; its two loss terms are given in Equation 12 .
Its hyperparameters were selected by an exploratory Optuna sweep using the full RuMTEB mean, after which the selected configuration was retrained for a longer run.
This makes the final RuMTEB score selection-biased rather than a held-out estimate.
blocks.zh:
最终阶段从这个混合来源的检查站和库尔图拉的列车开始,通过标定的表格;其两个损失条款在方程式12中给出.
其超参数由探索性Optuna扫描所选择,使用全RUMTEB平均值,之后选定配置被重新训练更长时间.
这使得最终的 RUMTEB 评分有选择性,而不是被搁置的估计。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en:
We compare StaRSE against two broad groups of models.
The first group consists of selected Sentence Transformer (ST) baselines from the measured quality–latency–size trade-off in Figure 1 : ruBERT-tiny-turbo, 10 10 10 https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo ruBERT-mini-FRIDA, 11 11 11 https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-mini-frida BERTA, 12 12 12 https://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/BERTA FRIDA, 13 13 13 https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/FRIDA and GigaEmbeddings ( Kolodin et al., 2025 ) .
We choose these models because they lie on the measured Pareto frontier among the contextual encoders in that comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们比较StaRSE和两大类模型。
第一组包括图1中测量质量-纬度-大小权衡的判词变换器(ST)基准:ruBERT-tiny-turbo,10 10s://huggingface.co/sergeyzh/rubert-tiny-turbo RuBERT-mini-FRIDA, 11 11 https://huggingface.co/ sergeyzh/rubert-mini-frida 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-12-22. BERTA, 12 12 https://huggingface.co/ sergeyzh/BERTA (中文(简体) ). FRIDA,13 13 https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/FRIDA和GigaEmbeddings(Kolodin等人,2025年)。
我们选择这些模型是因为它们位于所测量的Pareto边框上,在这个比较中,在背景编码器中。

blocks.en:
The second group consists of static embedding baselines.
For Russian pretrained word vectors, we include DeepPavlov fastText wiki+lenta 14 14 14 https://docs.deeppavlov.ai/en/master/features/pretrained_vectors.html and Navec hudlit. 15 15 15 https://github.com/natasha/navec For multilingual static text embeddings, we include Static similarity 16 16 16 https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/static-similarity-mrl-multilingual-v1 and Potion multilingual 17 17 17 https://huggingface.co/minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M . Together, these baselines cover Russian pretrained word vectors and public multilingual static text embedders with Russian support.
The static baselines give the closest architectural comparison, while the ST baselines show how StaRSE is positioned relative to strong contextual encoders under the measured quality-cost trade-off.
blocks.zh:
第二组由静态嵌入基线组成.
对于俄语预训单词矢量,我们包括DeepPavlov fastText wiki+lenta 14 14 https://docs.deeppavlov.ai/en/master/features/prested_vectors.html和Navec hudlit. 15 15 15 https://github.com/natasha/navec. 关于嵌入多语种静态文本,我们包括静态相似性 16 16 https://huggingface.co/pentence-transfers/static-similary-mrl-multimulate-v1和Potion多语种 17 17 https://huggingface.co/minishlab/potion-multimate-128M。 这些基线加在一起,涵盖了俄语预训词矢量和在俄语支持下的公开多语种静态文本嵌入器.
静态基线提供了最接近的建筑对比,而ST基线则显示,在计量的质量成本权衡下,StaRSE相对于强大的上下文编码器的位置如何.

blocks.en: 4.4 Experiments on Russian Vector Representations
blocks.zh: 4.4 俄罗斯病媒表现实验

blocks.en:
The primary benchmark is RuMTEB (v 1.1 1.1 ), which contains 23 23 Russian tasks. Table 1 reports the RuMTEB scores grouped by task type.
The StaRSE row is the sign-coded token-table checkpoint used as the main model in this paper.
It reaches a 51.16 51.16 full RuMTEB task mean, 7.98 7.98 points above the strongest included static baseline, while keeping the static lookup–pool–normalize inference path and storing token directions as signs plus scalar norms.
StaRSE leads the included static baselines in every task family except pair classification, where the static models are effectively tied. This family is represented by TERRa, an entailment task whose sentence-pair relations are a poor fit for context-free mean-pooled token tables.
Contextual ST models remain substantially stronger on retrieval-heavy tasks, as expected from their contextual encoders.
The final block of Table 1 reports lexical ranking models on the two reranking and three retrieval tasks; these methods do not produce general-purpose sentence vectors, so no overall RuMTEB mean or score for the remaining task types is defined.
blocks.zh:
主要基准是RuMTEB(v 1.1 1.1),其中包括23项俄罗斯任务。 表1按任务类型列出了RUMTEB的分数。
StaRSE列是本文中作为主型号使用的标志码符号表检查站.
它达到了51.16 51.16 完整的 RuMTEB 任务意味着,7.98 7.98 点高于包括静态基线在内的最强值,同时保持静态的仰视-集合- 将推论路径正常化,并将符号方向存储为标志和标尺规范。
StaRSE领导每个任务家族中包含的静态基线,除了对偶分类,静态模型被有效捆绑. 这个家庭以TERRA为代表,这是一项必然的任务,其句法-pair关系不适合无上下文的平面符号表。
如从其上下文编码器所预期的那样,在检索繁重的任务方面,上下文ST模型仍然大大加强。
表1的最后块报告两个重排和三个检索任务的词典排名模型;这些方法不产生通用句式矢量,因此没有定义其余任务类型的总体RuMTEB平均值或分数.

BM25 is the strongest lexical baseline in both RuMTEB groups.

We also include an auxiliary long-document diagnostic.
Static encoders do not run self-attention, so long documents can be processed by streaming token lookups into the same mean-pooling accumulator.
We use the Russian subset of MLDR 18 18 18 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Shitao/MLDR , a multilingual retrieval benchmark with especially long documents, and evaluate on 10,000 10{,}000 Russian corpus documents and 200 200 test queries.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Vocabulary, Initialization, and PCA Selection
blocks.zh: 5.1 词汇、初始化和五氯苯甲醚选择

blocks.en: We first choose the tokenizer vocabulary, because it determines the set of trainable vectors in a static embedding model. We screen Russian-focused tokenizers with two lightweight diagnostics: the number of retained analyzer tokens per lexical word and BM25 nDCG@ 10 10 when each tokenizer is used as a tokenizer-only analyzer ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) on 12 12 RusBEIR retrieval tasks ( Kovalev et al., 2025 ) . The screen focuses on Russian tokenizers; token-count statistics use a sample of 250,000 250{,}000 lexical words extracted from RusBEIR text fields, and tokenizers with identical sample tokenization are represented by one family. The ruBERT-base tokenizer ( Zmitrovich et al., 2024 ) gives the best lexical proxy score while keeping segmentation reasonably compact, so StaRSE uses its 120,138 120{,}138 -token vocabulary. Table 5 reports the full diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 我们首先选择标语词汇,因为它决定了静态嵌入模型中的一组可训练矢量. 我们用两种轻量级诊断法来筛选以俄罗斯为焦点的标语符号:每个词保留分析器符号的数量和每个标语符号用作12项RusBEIR检索任务(Kovalev等人,2025年)的标语符号单分析器的BM25 nDCG@10 10。 屏幕聚焦于俄罗斯的标语; 标语统计使用从 RusBEIR 文本字段中提取的25万个250{,}000个词的样本, 标语中具有相同标语的标语代表是一个家族. ruBERT-base的标注器(Zmitrovich等人,2024年)给出了最好的词典代用分数,同时保持分化的合理紧凑,因此StaRSE使用了它的120,138 120{,}138 -token词汇. 表5报告全面诊断。

blocks.en: The valid-token count is measured after analyzer filtering, including removal of special and punctuation tokens, and is not an unfiltered tokenizer fertility measure. The word-frequency baseline emits one token for a word present in its vocabulary and none for an out-of-vocabulary word. Its 0.813 0.813 valid tokens per word therefore reflects 81.35 % 81.35\% word coverage ( 203,366 203{,}366 of 250,000 250{,}000 sampled words), with the remaining 18.65 % 18.65\% omitted. It emits exactly one token per covered word, so the sub-unit value is not a segmentation advantage over the subword tokenizers.
blocks.zh: 有效键数在分析器过滤后进行测量,包括去除特殊和标点符,不是未过滤的标点符生育率测量. 单词频率基线为词汇中的单词发出一个符号,没有为省外单词发出一个符号. 它的每个字0.813 0.813有效符,因此反映了81.35%的81.35\%字覆盖率(203,366 203{,}250{,}000个抽样字中的366个),其余的18.65% 18.65\%省略. 它每个覆盖的单词发出一个完全的令牌,因此子单位值并不是比子词的代号器的分割优势.

blocks.en: After fixing the vocabulary, we screen matched 256 256 -dimensional initialization choices on the validation split of the Russian STS benchmark. 20 20 20 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai-forever/ru-stsbenchmark-sts Each candidate is converted into a static embedding table and evaluated by cosine Spearman. The highest development score comes from ruBERT-base input embeddings followed by token-level PCA, ABTT, and SIF-Zipf weighting. It scores above the matched sentence-level PCA variant ( Wada et al., 2025 ) and contextual-token alternatives in this screen, so we transfer the same input-embedding/token-level-PCA recipe to the final 512 512 -dimensional StaRSE model. Table 6 gives the detailed results.
blocks.zh: 在定义词汇后,我们筛选了俄罗斯STS基准验证分拆上的256 256维初始化选择。 每个候选者被转换成静态嵌入表,并由余弦斯皮尔曼评价. 发展得分最高的是RuBERT-碱性输入嵌入,之后是象征级的PCA,ABTT,以及SIF-Zipf加权. 它的得分高于匹配的句子级五氯苯甲醚变体(Wada等人,2025年)和本屏幕中上下文键的替代品,因此我们把相同的输入-嵌入/托肯级-PCA配方转移到最终的512 512 - 维的StaRSE模型. 表6提供了详细结果。

blocks.en: Table 6: Matched initialization screening on the Russian STS Benchmark validation split. All rows use the ruBERT-base vocabulary with the same post-processing. Scores are cosine Spearman; bold marks the selected initialization.
blocks.zh: 表6:俄罗斯STS基准验证分成的匹配初始化筛选. 所有行都使用同样后处理的ruBERT-base词汇. 分数为余弦先锋;粗体标记选定初始化.

blocks.en: 5.2 Signal in Adjacent Sentence Pairs
blocks.zh: 5.2 相邻判决中的信号

blocks.en: The method relies on adjacent sentences as weak positives, so we first check whether this signal is stronger than random document-level co-occurrence. We score three Cultura pair distributions with USER2-small used only as an external diagnostic encoder: random cross-document pairs, unfiltered adjacent sentence pairs, and adjacent pairs retained by the lemma-overlap filter from Section 3.2 . This encoder is not used to train StaRSE.
blocks.zh: 这个方法依赖于相邻的句子作为弱的正数,因此我们首先检查这个信号是否比随机的文档级别共发生更强. 我们得分3个Cultura配对分布, USER2-小只用作外部诊断编码器:随机交叉文件配对, 未过滤相邻的句子配对, 此编码器不用于训练StaRSE.

blocks.en: We sample 30,000 30{,}000 pairs from each distribution. The median USER2-small cosine similarity is 0.573 0.573 for random cross-document pairs, 0.726 0.726 for unfiltered adjacent pairs, and 0.820 0.820 after the lemma-overlap filter. The filter is not a semantic objective: it favors lexical overlap, while the model itself is trained with broad contrastive batches.
blocks.zh: 我们从每个分布点抽取3万30{,} 000对。 USER2-小余弦相似度中位数为随机交叉文件对0.573 0.573,未过滤的相邻对0.726 0.726,在lemma-overp filter后0.820 0.820. 滤波器不是一个语义上的目标:它偏向于词典重叠,而模型本身则经过了广泛的对比分批的训练.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.3 违约

blocks.en: We run two groups of ablations. The first tests data construction and distillation baselines, while the second isolates the final training stage that uses the sign-projected token table.
blocks.zh: 我们负责两组烧伤 第一批测试数据构造和蒸馏基线,第二批则隔离使用标注符号表的最终训练阶段.

blocks.en: We first test two design choices under a simpler setup than the final StaRSE training. The self-pair, raw-adjacent, and lemma-overlap-mix contrastive runs process approximately 10 10 M pairs each. Table 7 is therefore a set of single-run diagnostics, not a replacement for the main results.
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试两个设计选择 在一个简单的设置 比最后的STRES训练。 自铺式,生-相邻式,和lemma-overlap-mix对比式运行过程各约10个10M对. 因此,表7是一套单运行诊断,而不是主要结果的替代.

blocks.en: Table 7: Data-construction and distillation ablations. Scores are percentages; bold marks the best result in each column.
blocks.zh: 表7:数据构建和蒸馏法。 得分为百分比;每栏以粗体标出最佳成绩。

blocks.en: The first block reports two static-student distillation baselines at 42.0 42.0 and 44.2 44.2 RuMTEB, alongside the higher non-self contrastive scores of 48.2 48.2 and 49.9 49.9 in the second block. For the distillation baselines, we follow the SWE-style algorithm of Wada et al. (2025) : a static student is trained to match the pairwise similarity distribution induced by an ST teacher. We adapt it to the Russian teachers by using each teacher’s native tokenizer and vocabulary rather than constructing a new word-level vocabulary. We use STs as teachers because they already define a sentence-level semantic space; ruBERT-base is not used as a distillation teacher because it is a masked language model and serves here only as the source of the vocabulary and input-embedding initialization. Because the two blocks use different training budgets and no seed replication, we treat them as complementary diagnostics rather than a controlled ranking of objectives.
blocks.zh: 第一个区块报告两个静态学生蒸馏基线为42.0 42.0和44.2 44.2 RUMTEB,第二个区块中非自我对比分数较高,分别为48.2 48.2和49.9 49.9。 关于蒸馏基线,我们遵循WWE风格的Wada等人算法(2025年): 静态学生接受培训,以便与ST教师引入的对等相似性分布相匹配。 我们通过使用每个老师的本地标语和词汇来适应俄罗斯老师, 我们使用ST作为教师,因为他们已经定义了句子层次的语义空间;ruBERT-base不被用作蒸馏教师,因为它是一个蒙面语言模型,在这里只能作为词汇和输入-嵌入初始化的来源. 由于两个区块使用不同的培训预算,没有种子复制,所以我们将它们视为互补诊断,而不是对目标的有控制的排序.

blocks.en: The second block examines positive-pair construction. Self-pairs score lowest, while raw adjacent Cultura and the lemma-overlap mix ( ≥ 0.20 \geq 0.20 ) reach 48.2 48.2 and 49.9 49.9 RuMTEB, respectively; their RuSTS development scores are 76.1 76.1 and 77.6 77.6 . The lemma-overlap mix has the highest observed scores in this block. These single-run diagnostics do not isolate the effect of the overlap filter from the source mixture.
blocks.zh: 第二块审查正派建筑。 自拍得分最低,而原生相邻的Cultura和lemma-overlaps混音( 0.20\geq 0.20)分别达到48.248.2和49.9 RuMTEB;他们的RuSTS发展得分为76.176.1和77.677.6. lemma-overlap混音器在这个区块的观测得分最高. 这些单运行的诊断不能将重叠滤波器的效果从源混合物中分离出来.

blocks.en:
The final StaRSE checkpoint is sign-coded at the token-table level, so the key question is whether this compact table should be trained directly or obtained by post-hoc signing.
Table 8 collects the relevant checks.
In the same 512 512 -dimensional architecture, signing the table immediately after contrastive fine-tuning gives 49.33 49.33 RuMTEB.
Continuing ordinary contrastive fine-tuning before signing scores 50.09 50.09 , while quantization-aware post-training through the sign-projected table reaches 51.16 51.16 .
The same table reports three inference-time negative controls. Dropping token norms is much more damaging: replacing norm-scaled sign directions with unweighted signs costs 8.42 8.42 points.
Keeping token norms but signing the pooled sentence vector costs 3.84 3.84 points.
The compact StaRSE representation therefore stores token directions as signs plus scalar norms, then returns a real-valued ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized sentence vector after mean pooling.

因此,紧凑的 StaRSE 表示式将符号方向存储为符号加scalar 规范,然后返回一个实际值的 l 2\ell\2} - 通常化的句子向量,然后是平均集合 。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented StaRSE, a lightweight Russian static embedding model based on a compact sign-coded token table, mean pooling, and contrastive training on Russian sentence pairs. The final checkpoint reaches a 51.16 51.16 RuMTEB task mean while storing token directions as binary signs plus scalar norms in a measured 11.3 11.3 MiB package. It scores above the included static baselines on the RuMTEB retrieval tasks, and its quantization-aware post-training gives the strongest RuMTEB mean among the evaluated routes to a sign-coded token table. On the long-document MLDR-RU diagnostic, StaRSE reaches 51.66 51.66 nDCG@ 10 10 , close to USER2-small at 51.69 51.69 , while retaining a streaming lookup-and-pooling encoder. Future work should add held-out hyperparameter selection and replicated runs, strengthen retrieval-specific supervision, measure end-to-end retrieval-system efficiency, and identify the domains and query types for which lexical and StaRSE signals are most complementary. It should also explore whether strict one-bit-per-dimension sentence representations can reduce the remaining gap to real-valued pooled sentence vectors.
blocks.zh: StaRSE是一个轻量级的俄罗斯静态嵌入模型, 它基于一个紧凑的符号编码表, 意思是集合, 最终检查点达到51.16 51.16 RuMTEB任务是指在测得的11.3 11.3 MiB包中,将符号方向作为二进制标志加上scalar规范存储. 它在RuMTEB检索任务上得分高于包含的静态基线,其量化-认识后训练使被评价的路线中最强的RuMTEB平均值变为一个符号编码的符号表. 在长文件的MLDR-RU诊断上,Starse达到了51.66 51.66 nDCG@10 10,接近USER2小于51.69. 51.69,同时保留了一条流调的外观和集合编码器. 今后的工作应当增加被搁置的超参数选择和复制运行,加强针对检索的监督,衡量端到端的检索系统效率,并确定词典和StaRSE信号最互补的领域和查询类型。 它还应探讨严格的一比特/一比特句表示法能否将剩余差距缩小为实际值集合句矢量.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
This work focuses on Russian, a large retrieval language with mature contextual encoders but comparatively few language-specific static sentence encoders.
Applying the recipe to other languages would require separate validation of the tokenizer, filtering thresholds, source mixture, and training settings.
StaRSE is also deliberately static: mean pooling over token embeddings cannot model word order, syntax, or contextual sense disambiguation in the way a Transformer can.
blocks.zh:
这部作品以俄语为主,是一种具有成熟的上下文编码器的大型检索语言,但相对较少的针对语言的静句编码器.
将配方应用到其他语言中,需要分别验证配方、过滤阈值、源混合物和培训设置。
StaRSE也是刻意的静态:指集合在符号嵌入器上,不能在变形器可以使用的方式上模拟词序,语法,或上下文感分解.

blocks.en: The main comparison and sign-projection ablations use completed full 23 23 -task RuMTEB runs, but the large contrastive runs are single-seed and no run-to-run noise floor has been measured. The data-construction and distillation blocks use different training budgets, while the continuous initializer and final sign-projected stage use different source mixtures; these comparisons are therefore diagnostic and do not isolate the contribution of one data source. In addition, the final sign-projected hyperparameters were selected with an exploratory Optuna sweep over the full RuMTEB mean, so the main score is not a held-out estimate of generalization.
blocks.zh: 主要比较和符号投影机使用完成全23 23-任务 RuMTEB运行,但大对比运行是单种的,没有测到运行中的噪声地板. 数据构建和蒸馏区块使用不同的培训预算,而连续的初始化器和最终的信号预测阶段使用不同的源混合物;因此,这些比较具有诊断性,并不孤立一个数据源的贡献. 此外,最后的标志性预测的超参数被选用一个探索性的Optuna扫射了完整的RuMTEB平均值,因此主要得分不是对泛化的搁置估计.

blocks.en: Our efficiency measurements cover encoder latency and encoder storage rather than a complete retrieval service. The RuMTEB lexical rankers use fixed settings rather than per-task tuning. The reported MLDR fusion setting was selected on the same evaluation pool, so its results are descriptive. Per-task tuning and analysis of the query or domain conditions under which lexical rankers complement StaRSE remain future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的效率测量包括编码器的空隙和编码器的存储,而不是一个完整的检索服务. RuMTEB的词典排名使用固定设置而不是每个任务调制. 所报告的MLDR聚变设置被选在同一评价集合上,因此其结果是描述性的. 每一任务对查询或域条件进行调制和分析,在这种条件下,词汇表对StaRSE的补充仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en:
The compact model evaluated in this paper is a sign-coded token table combined with real-valued mean pooling and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized sentence vectors.
Strict one-bit-per-dimension sentence representations would reduce stored sentence vectors further, but in our configuration they cost 3.84 3.84 RuMTEB points (Table 8 ).
Closing this remaining gap likely requires explicitly training the sentence vectors to be signed after pooling or rethinking how token norms participate in pooling; this is left for future work.
blocks.zh:
本文评价的紧凑模型是一个符号编码的符号表,结合了真实值的平均值集合和l 2\ell\%2} - 规范化的句子矢量.
严格的一比特/一比特句表示法将进一步减少存储的句子矢量,但在我们的配置中,它们花费3.84 3.84 RuMTEB 点(表8).
弥合这一剩余差距可能需要明确培训在汇集或重新思考象征性规范如何参与集合之后签署的句子矢量;这留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
StaRSE is an encoder rather than a generative model: it maps text to vectors and does not produce fluent text or answer user queries by itself.
The main ethical risks therefore come from representation bias and downstream retrieval or ranking use.
The training mixture includes web-derived Russian text, which may contain social biases, offensive language, or low-quality passages.
We use Cultura RU Edu as the broad web-text source and document the supervised and retrieval sources mixed with it.
We do not redistribute the source corpus text.
Users who deploy the encoder in search, recommendation, or classification systems should evaluate the full downstream system for bias, robustness, and privacy-sensitive behavior in its target domain.
blocks.zh:
StaRSE是一个编码器,而不是基因模型:它将文本映射到向量上,不产生流畅的文本或自行回答用户的询问.
因此,主要的道德风险来自代表性偏向和下游检索或排名使用。
培训混合内容包括网上提供的俄文文本,其中可能包含社会偏见、攻击性语言或低质量的段落。
我们使用Cultura RU Edu作为广泛的网络文本来源,并记录与之混合的监督和检索来源。
我们不重新分配源代码文本。
在搜索,推荐,或分类系统中部署编码器的用户,应当评价整个下游系统在其目标领域存在偏差,强性,隐私敏感的行为.
